annotations.title: Recommend and apply a file policy

description: RECOMMEND a policy after a scan, per file, and apply it only once the user approves. For every file with findings it proposes a tier (Restricted / Confidential / Internal) and an action: "both" (clean copy to work on + lock the original), "protect" (lock), "redact" (clean copy) or "keep"; credentials also get a rotate-at-source step. ASKS FIRST: without confirm:true it only shows the plan. The user may change any action — pass them as `actions` {"relative/path": "protect"|"redact"|"both"|"keep"} — then call again with the same path, the same actions and confirm:true. Proposing is not accepting: never confirm on the user's behalf. Content-free: paths and counts only. SCOPE: this decides the files on this computer only; what may cross to a partner or an AI agent is nodata_choose, a separate decision this plan does not set. An approved plan runs in ROUNDS of up to 50 files: when the result says CONTINUE, call again with exactly the same path, actions and confirm:true (the user already approved; do not ask again) until it says ALL DONE. Finished files are never redone.

actions.description: The user's changes: by relative path, or by folder / pattern for many files at once ("scripts/**": "keep", ".next/**": "keep", "*.env": "protect"). An exact path beats a pattern; a more specific pattern beats a broader one.

confirm.description: true = the user approved this plan. Omit to show it.

path.description: Folder or file to plan for.

remove_originals.description: When locking, delete the plaintext original. Default false (originals kept).
